name: Vienna
author: Rmerr1
description:
Vienna as it could have been. All 23 districts inside the Stadtgrenze, extended
south-east to take in Flughafen Wien-Schwechat.

Residents come from Statistik Austria's register-based INSPIRE 100 m population
grid - measured counts, not estimates. Workplace demand is modelled: Vienna's
published employment total distributed across OSM office, retail, industrial and
institutional features by a building-type dasymetric. Commute flows come from a
doubly-constrained gravity model calibrated to Vienna's real median commute, with
driving times routed by OSRM.

3,829 demand points, 33,734 population groups, ~1.49M modelled trips. Special
demand for the airport, 18 university and FH campuses, 12 hospitals, major venues,
and 7 outside-connection corridors carrying the ~250k daily Umland in-commuters.

The first Austrian map in the registry.
